tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.special_circumstance: cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2) above
tuples.quote: (5) In cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2) above, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.

tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.quote: However, in case of term loans, pre-payment charges, if levied by a UCB, shall be based on the amount being prepaid.

tuples.subject: prepayment_charge
tuples.special_circumstance: cash credit/overdraft facilities; pre-payment on closure of the facility before the due date
tuples.quote: In case of cash credit/ overdraft facilities, pre-payment charges on closure of the facility before the due date shall be levied on an amount not exceeding the sanctioned limit.
